BiblicalUsage: Hazeroth is a camp on the wilderness march, named as the place Israel abides after the craving at Kibroth-hattaavah, the place they leave when Miriam and Aaron oppose Moses, and a stop on the long list of the journey. It is a camp of complaint and of opposition.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God does not hide the ugly camps. Hazeroth is where the people craved and where Miriam spoke against Moses, and the march went on anyway.
RelatedEvents: The Quail and the Craving at Kibroth-hattaavah; Miriam and Aaron Oppose Moses
